name: Teen Crush
summary: Teen Crush is an aesthetic and "concept genre" primarily associated within the "4th Generation" of K-pop music.
description:
Teen Crush is an aesthetic and "concept genre" primarily associated within the "4th Generation" of K-pop music. It functions as a stylistic synthesis of the aggressive and performance-oriented concept of Girl Crush and the youthful, preppy visuals of the "High Teen" aesthetic. Unlike the darker, more mature imagery of traditional Girl Crush, Teen Crush utilizes high-saturation color palettes, kitsch accessories, and streetwear elements to project an image of youthful rebellion and confidence.

The aesthetic is characterized by the subversion of traditional school uniforms and sportswear, mixing them with industrial or punk -inspired elements such as combat boots, chains, and neon textiles. Musically, it accompanies "chant-heavy", densely performance based dance-pop and EDM tracks that emphasize self-love and independence over romantic themes.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Confidence, non-conformity, youth, energy
